desc: Implement sliding-window median cost with dual Fenwick trees (counts + sums) over compressed coordinates; cost = median*cnt_lo - sum_lo + sum_hi - median*cnt_hi, median = lower median via Fenwick kth query.
Implement selection DP: prev[j-1] row over start indices, cur[i] = min(cur[i-1], prev[i-x] + cost[i]); answer = row k at last index; exactly-k suffices since costs are non-negative.
Verify against both provided examples (expect 8 and 3) and brute-force on small random inputs (n <= 12, x <= 4, k <= 3) comparing to exhaustive per-window sort + recursive DP.
Handle edge cases: negative values, x == n, k == 1, k*x == n (forced tiling), all-equal elements (cost 0); confirm O(n log n + n*k) fits limits; finalize code in required format.
